emails.subject: Sales visibility at {{company}}
emails.body:
Dear {{first_name}},

I'm reaching out to ask how you currently keep track of open quotations and your sales team's next steps.

Intrix CRM helps companies bring customer information, quotations and sales activities together. This gives management a clearer view of sales and helps the team follow up on open opportunities at the right time.

Would you be open to a brief conversation about this?

Best regards,
Matej Gostisa

emails.subject: Re: Sales visibility at {{company}}
emails.body:
Dear {{first_name}},

I recently wrote to you about sales visibility at your company.

Intrix lets you see which quotations are open, what has been agreed with customers and who is responsible for the next step—all in one place. This means less time gathering updates from colleagues and less chance of a sales opportunity being left without follow-up.

If this is relevant for your team, I'd be happy to show you how it works in practice on a brief call.

Best regards,
Matej Gostisa

emails.subject: Re: Sales visibility at {{company}}
emails.body:
Dear {{first_name}},

I'm getting back in touch to see whether improving visibility into sales and customer information is currently relevant for your company.

If so, we could arrange a brief conversation. If someone else oversees this area, I'd appreciate being pointed in the right direction.

If it isn't a priority at the moment, I completely understand.

Best regards,
Matej Gostisa
